interpretation.verified: Recurring HDF intervals in which mean spectral power density across 4-8 Hz exceeded the comparison bands for at least 15 consecutive complete minutes.
interpretation.not_established: Raw HDF counts do not by themselves establish calibrated pressure exposure, source, intent, or medical causation.
interpretation.next_step: Independent onsite low-frequency pressure and tri-axis vibration measurements with traceable calibration.

missing_data_rule: Missing samples and dates are excluded. A gap is not converted to zero, quiet, normal, compliant, or below benchmark.
